raw_evidence_tuple.input_type: exactly 11 positional values, each a built-in bytes instance; bytearray, memoryview, str, decoded object, subclass, path, URL, iterator, resolver and extra/missing position refuse before JSON parsing
positions: edge_set_bytes: canonical JSON array of EdgeSetEntry.v1
raw_evidence_tuple.cardinality_and_variants: There are eight signed envelope positions (root PIS, phase PIS, ScopeIntent, CES, PEA, BVP, CAS, selected admission) and three unsigned byte positions. In bootstrap only, root_pis_bytes and phase_pis_bytes are two required positions whose bytes must be equal; in scope-action/replay-pre-final they must be different positions and phase_pis has the mapped stage/replay variant. No other duplicate-byte rule is imposed.
raw_evidence_tuple.not_supplied: No IssuanceBasis, gate, scope authorization, document, planned-capture-set, BVP plan payload, receipt, resolver, registry, broker, lifecycle object, or capture input is accepted. Their digest fields are syntax-checked only unless a rule below names a supplied operand.

canonical_and_scalar_rules.raw_canonical: For each bytes position call frozen dskit.pipeline.trust._load_canonical_json exactly once. It accepts UTF-8 JSON with duplicate keys and non-finite constants refused, then requires byte-for-byte equality to trust._canonical_bytes: json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",",":"), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False).encode("ascii").
canonical_and_scalar_rules.Obj: JSON object with exactly the listed keys, no null/default/alias/extra/missing key.
canonical_and_scalar_rules.Arr[T]: JSON array whose every element is T; any stated ordering and uniqueness rule is mandatory.
canonical_and_scalar_rules.S: JSON string (including empty only where the ADR did not prohibit it); no coercion.
canonical_and_scalar_rules.I: JSON integer, not bool, finite by JSON parsing; no float/coercion.
canonical_and_scalar_rules.Bool: built-in bool only; truthy/falsy substitutes are not bool.
canonical_and_scalar_rules.signature: S, not a locally decoded base64 value. ADR-0125 specifies signature as a field but not a text encoding, and frozen ReleaseKeyring.verify accepts the signature argument without a codec contract. The exact parsed JSON string value is passed unchanged as its signature argument; no base64 alphabet, padding, or bytes conversion is invented here.
canonical_and_scalar_rules.local_self: For an unsigned object, SHA-256(trust._canonical_bytes(object with exactly its named self field removed)) equals that field.
canonical_and_scalar_rules.signed_self_and_preimage: For every signed envelope, let preimage be trust._canonical_bytes(object with exactly its named self field and signature removed). SHA-256(preimage) equals its named self field. This same preimage, not original envelope bytes and not a decoded signature, is the message passed to ReleaseKeyring.verify.

signed_envelope_rules.common: not_before_ms <= issued_at_ms <= expires_at_ms. Call clock.now_ms once, require I, and use that one value for every inclusive window. For each envelope call keyring.verify(key.key_id, key.key_version, issued_at_ms, preimage, signature) and require return is True. Then call revocations.is_unrevoked(revocation_snapshot_sha256, key.key_id, key.key_version, now_ms) and require return is True.

profile_and_local_link_rules.local_pis_ces_cas_projection: For every CES entry, find exactly one phase-PIS entry with equal input_id. Its complete canonical PublishedInputEntry bytes must equal CES.published_input bytes. Convert CES entry to PlannedCaptureEntry by adding schema dskit.planned-capture-entry/v1, the common subject_ref, and its computed planned_entry_sha256. The converted array in CES complete-canonical-item order must equal CAS.entries item-for-item, including cardinality. This proves P(CES)==P(CAS), not P(BVP).
profile_and_local_link_rules.bvp_limit: BVP.plan_sha256 and BVP.planned_capture_set_sha256 are H values and are only directly equal to the supplied fields above. The preflight neither receives nor hashes BVP's plan payload or PlannedCaptureSet, so it makes no P(BVP) or BVP-plan-preimage claim.

embedded_dag_rules: Scope action_intents and ActionIntentSet.entries are byte-identical arrays; they contain each ActionId exactly once and are sorted by (topological_position, action_id). Scope action_intent_set_sha256 equals ActionIntentSet self.
Scope replay_intents and ReplayIntentSet.entries are byte-identical arrays; they are exactly control and crash-restart sorted by replay_id. Scope replay_intent_set_sha256 equals ReplayIntentSet self.

edge_set_bytes is a canonical Arr[EdgeSetEntry], sorted by (consumer_action_id,binding_id,predecessor_action_id,output_name,output_schema,output_version,purpose), unique by complete canonical item, and SHA-256(edge_set_bytes) equals Scope edge_set_sha256. action_dag_sha256 is H-only because ADR-0125 does not state its exact preimage object.

For each ActionIntent, predecessor_action_ids is sorted unique; predecessor_output_refs is sorted by its stated full tuple and unique complete canonical item; required_input_contracts is sorted unique binding_id; root_published_input_ids is sorted unique.

The distinct predecessor_action_id projection of predecessor_output_refs equals predecessor_action_ids. Each predecessor ID names a different in-scope ActionIntent with strictly smaller topological_position. Roots have empty predecessor IDs and refs; nonroots have empty root_published_input_ids.

For each predecessor-output InputContract, exactly one EdgeSetEntry has its consumer_action_id equal to this action_id, binding_id equal to the contract binding_id, and predecessor/output/schema/version/purpose equal to exactly one predecessor_output_ref. Every EdgeSetEntry has exactly one such contract and ref. A published-input contract has no EdgeSetEntry with its binding_id. This is the closed local binding; source_ref remains S-only because ADR-0125 gives no local target grammar.

revocation_seam.abc: abstract is_unrevoked(snapshot_sha256: str, key_id: str, key_version: int, now_ms: int) -> bool
revocation_seam.argument_admission: Before call, preflight requires snapshot_sha256 H, key_id S, key_version I and now_ms I. The public preflight constructor accepts only an instance of HistoricalStudyRevocations, ReleaseKeyring, and TrustedClock; callable, mapping, duck-typed, registry-selected, null, and subclassed-by-data substitutes refuse. Test doubles must explicitly subclass the ABC.
revocation_seam.snapshot_semantics: True means the injected verifier has an authenticated immutable snapshot identified by exactly snapshot_sha256 and that snapshot contains no revocation for exactly (key_id,key_version) effective at now_ms. Unknown or unavailable snapshot, absent key status, invalid argument, stale/lazy lookup, return other than built-in True, or any exception means refusal. The seam does no network/store read and cannot treat unknown as an empty revocation set.
revocation_seam.construction_admission: Only a private preflight factory receiving the three explicit trusted objects creates the preflight; parsed bytes never name a class, registry, factory, import path, or revocation implementation. This is an interface admission rule, not a durable authorization boundary; output remains non-authorizing.

correction_mapping.P0-0045-M01: Resolved by the exact 11-position tuple and explicit variants. P(CES)==P(CAS) has CES, phase PIS, and CAS operands; P(BVP) is expressly not claimed without BVP plan/PlannedCaptureSet bytes.
correction_mapping.P0-0045-M02: Resolved by closed scalar/nested/envelope tables and one preimage rule. Signature is passed as its unchanged JSON string because frozen ReleaseKeyring supplies no codec contract; no B64 rule is invented.
correction_mapping.P0-0045-M03: Resolved by narrowing both name and claims to structural/signature preflight. issuance_basis_sha256 is H-only; no result is called ADR-verified or a predecessor/authority proof.
correction_mapping.P0-0045-M04: Resolved for all ADR-defined local facts by supplied ActionIntentSet/EdgeSet bytes and closed membership/order/ref/binding rules. The only omitted relation, source_ref target semantics, is expressly outside ADR's local grammar and output claims.
correction_mapping.P0-0045-M05: Resolved by the frozen ABC, exact-bool/exception/unknown-snapshot refusal semantics, and closed factory/injection admission; no caller-selected registry or lazy fallback exists.
